caption:
"Why is my physio asking how I'm sleeping?" Mr Turtle wondered the same thing.

Pain is shaped by more than tissues. Research suggests a run of poor sleep can make the nervous system more sensitive, and stress can raise muscle tension. Your work sets the daily load your body handles too.

Knowing a little about your sleep, stress and routine helps us build a plan that fits real life, like shorter exercises in a flat-out week. You only share what you're comfortable with.

Our team at Hybrid Physio looks at the whole picture. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
